evidence.claim: George Lee wanted his mining town to become Colorado’s capital and himself to become governor.
evidence.quote: its founders wished it had become the capital of Colorado. In order to try and garner interest, Lee changed the name to Capitol City as he had also dreamed of becoming the state's governor.

evidence.claim: He founded it as Galena City in 1877, then changed the name to Capitol City to attract interest.
evidence.quote: Capitol City was founded in 1877 by George Lee and was originally named Galena City.

evidence.claim: Lee built a smelter and sawmill, while the town acquired a schoolhouse, cabins and businesses.

evidence.quote: When the cost of silver dropped, so did the residents. Lawsuits and difficult transportation also sped up the town's downfall.
